Messages.Author: David Pontes
Messages.Body:
Hello all! Here's another one for Scott:

There's a political action being called. There's a lot of
discussion prior to the decision to not to block (as usual in my
playgroup, as I believe it's in all playgroups), but since the acting
player has bribes, no-one blocks. He plays bribes. Everyone with votes
already said they'd vote in favor, but the weenie player who had no votes
to cast plays Delaying Tactics.

Question is: who gains pool? Everyone who had stated their
intentions to cast votes? No-one, for it could be argued that the weenie
played the DT before the acting minion played bribes (thus making the
problem a fast-talk ability)? Or only the acting player for the pool gain
for him is immediate, and there is a "before votes are cast" phase that
enables the player of the DT to play it before any votes are cast (and
therefore only the acting meth gained a pool)?

I'd be very thankful if you could send any answers directly to me also,
for the news server is kinda screwy around here lately.

David Pontes

P.S.-> Any news on the perkygoth (the enigmatic character on the VtES
index)? I'd really like to know where did that come from...

8[

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson

> > vote (as per DT text), but _all_ minions of that meth are prevented from

> > that as "reasonably useless"???
>
> Well, certainly much less useful than it would be. Sure, they're
> prohibited from ConAgging you, so they KRC you instead. Big punishment.

"Much"?

Any other vampire could call that KRC in any event (whether you play
with DT as written and NRA as DCI implemented, or if you add your
restriction to either the DT or NRA rule).

The ruling merely states that the vampire who had his political
action delayed has not completed a political action - which is
derivable from the implementation of NRA (by the RT), and from the
name of the card (the PA is delayed, so hasn't occured yet).

So, it is less useful than it would be if you gave it more power.
(i.e., tacked a "this vampire cannot attempt a political
action for the remainder of the current turn" restriction onto
the card text of Delaying Tactics.)

All cards are less useful than they would be if you gave them
more power.


